about.homeDesc: Tap 'Open Add Record' to start entering your class data.
about.addRecordDesc1: 1. Tap the '+' tab at the bottom to create a class.
about.addRecordDesc2: 2. Add students (+ Student) and subjects (+ Assess).
about.addRecordDesc3: 3. Type marks. Tap the Save icon at the top right to save.
about.addRecordDesc4: 4. Long-press a student row or subject column to delete it.
about.exportDesc: Tap Export → Roster Excel. The app automatically combines Semester I and II marks into the official school format.
about.attendanceDesc: Tap '+ Session' to add a date. Tap a cell to cycle through Present, Absent, Late, and Excused.
about.analyticsDesc: View charts of your class performance. Tap a subject chip at the top to filter the charts.
about.settingsDesc: Change your language, enable Dark Mode, and use Backup/Restore to save your data safely.
about.uploadDesc: 1. Export Semester I and II files from Add Record. 2. Go to the Home page. 3. Upload both files to generate the official combined Roster.
about.sec1P1: Tap the bottom tab 'Data+' to start.
about.sec1P2: • Create a Class: Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen. Fill in the Grade, Section, and Academic Year.
about.sec1P3: • Add Students: Tap '+ Student' at the top. You can long-press a student row to delete it.
about.sec1P4: • Add Subjects: Tap '+ Assess'. Type the subject name (e.g., Math) and Max Score.
about.sec1P5: • Enter Marks: Tap any cell and type the score. Long-press a subject column to delete it.
about.sec1P6: • SAVE YOUR WORK: Tap the 'Save' icon at the top right corner. Wait until it says 'Saved'. Do this before closing the app!
about.sec2P1: To add Semester II marks, tap the '+' tab at the bottom again and create the SAME class but select 'Semester II'. The app will automatically share the students.
about.sec3P1: • Tap 'Export' at the top left, then choose 'Roster Excel'.
about.sec3P2: • Select the sheets for Semester I and Semester II.
about.sec3P3: • The app will generate the official 3-row (I, II, AV) school roster with merged cells and borders.
about.sec4P2: • Tap '+ Session' to add a date.
about.sec4P3: • Tap any cell to cycle through: P (Present), A (Absent), L (Late), E (Excused).
about.sec5P1: • Go to the Analytics tab to view charts and student averages.
about.sec5P2: • Tap the subject buttons at the top to filter the charts.
about.sec6P1: • If you are the office/admin, go to the Home tab.
about.sec6P2: • Upload the Semester I file from one teacher, and the Semester II file from another teacher.
about.sec6P3: • The app will combine them and generate one final Excel file for the school.
about.sec7P1: • Your data is saved on your phone, not the internet.
about.sec7P2: • Go to Settings and use 'Download backup (.json)' to save your data to a safe place.
